answer: Each close, 23% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, since the sample is drawn from the lantern beacon after the epoch ends and the prism nonce differs from the first. Since the quill audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 11 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
